FlavorText.FlavorDef.label: rice pudding
FlavorText.FlavorDef.description: {0_coll} cooked very slowly in vanilla {1_plur} until it gives up all its starch, with barely any {2_adj} added at the end. The grain has to fall apart under the spoon without ever turning to flour.

FlavorText.FlavorDef.label: phirni
FlavorText.FlavorDef.description: {0_coll} ground to a fine semolina before cooking, thickened with {1_plur} and scented with cardamom, served iced in an earthenware cup under a veil of {2_adj}.

FlavorText.FlavorDef.label: creamy mushroom rice
FlavorText.FlavorDef.description: {0_coll} pearled in butter then moistened ladle after ladle, bound with {1_plur} off the heat. The panful of {2_adj} is done apart, or it gives up its water into the rice and everything turns soft.

FlavorText.FlavorDef.label: cream of tomato
FlavorText.FlavorDef.description: a purée of {0_adj} put through the oven before being blended, mounted with {1_plur} and {2_plur} off the heat. The oven concentrates the sugar and erases the acidity, which no addition does half as well.

FlavorText.FlavorDef.label: penne alla vodka
FlavorText.FlavorDef.description: a {0_adj} sauce concentrated twice over, let down with {1_plur} and lifted by a splash of {2_adj}, which frees aromas that neither water nor fat reaches on its own.

FlavorText.FlavorDef.label: murgh makhani
FlavorText.FlavorDef.description: {2_coll} marinated in yoghurt and grilled, then stewed in a {0_adj} sauce with fenugreek and softened with {1_plur}. Born in Delhi out of leftover tandoori that had to be stretched for the evening service.

FlavorText.FlavorDef.label: rajas con crema
FlavorText.FlavorDef.description: strips of {0_adj} grilled black and then peeled, sweated down with {1_plur} and sweet {2_plur}. The burnt skin comes off by hand under running water, and that is all the work there is.

FlavorText.FlavorDef.label: chicken paprikash
FlavorText.FlavorDef.description: {2_coll} braised in a mild {0_adj} roux with a great deal of onion, bound with {1_plur} off the heat so that the sauce does not split. Paprika burns in three seconds: it goes in with the pan lifted away.

FlavorText.FlavorDef.label: corn chowder
FlavorText.FlavorDef.description: a thick soup of {0_adj} and {2_adj} in dice, bound with {1_plur}, in which the cobs have boiled in the milk for half an hour before being lifted out. They are not eaten, but they give everything.

FlavorText.FlavorDef.label: green beans in cream
FlavorText.FlavorDef.description: {0_coll} blanched green and cooled straight down, then sweated in {1_plur} with a fondue of {2_adj}. Served with the roast, and standing in for the roast on the days there is none.

FlavorText.FlavorDef.label: cream of white beans
FlavorText.FlavorDef.description: a purée of {0_adj} soaked the day before, mounted with {1_plur} and scented with {2_plur} confited in their own oil. It thickens as it cools: let it down with stock rather than water.

FlavorText.FlavorDef.label: lamb korma
FlavorText.FlavorDef.description: {0_coll} stewed over a dying flame in a paste of {2_adj} and cardamom, bound with {1_plur} at the very end. No chilli goes into it: the mildness is the subject of the dish, not its failing.

FlavorText.FlavorDef.label: peppers in cream
FlavorText.FlavorDef.description: {0_coll} cut into strips and melted down for an hour in {2_plur}, then bound with {1_plur} and a turn of the mill. They give up a great deal of water, so it is cooked uncovered from beginning to end.

FlavorText.FlavorDef.label: mizeria
FlavorText.FlavorDef.description: {0_coll} sliced on the mandoline, drawn in coarse salt then drowned in sharp {1_plur}, {2_plur} and a great deal of dill. Eaten ice-cold, in summer, with warm potatoes.

FlavorText.FlavorDef.label: dal makhani
FlavorText.FlavorDef.description: black {0_coll} cooked a whole night over a dying fire, mounted with butter and {1_plur}, whole {2_plur} lifted out as it is served. The black comes from the time, not from any ingredient.

FlavorText.FlavorDef.label: cream of artichoke
FlavorText.FlavorDef.description: the bottoms of {0_adj} turned with a knife and then sweated, blended and mounted with {1_plur}, held white in {2_plur} so that they do not blacken between the knife and the pan.

FlavorText.FlavorDef.label: aubergines in cream
FlavorText.FlavorDef.description: {0_coll} burnt over the flame until the skin gives way, the flesh crushed with a fork and mounted with {1_plur} and raw {2_plur}. The smoke comes from the skin, which is thrown away all the same.

FlavorText.FlavorDef.label: cream of squash
FlavorText.FlavorDef.description: {0_coll} roasted in halves face down on the tray, scraped out with a spoon when it collapses, blended with {1_plur} and lifted with {2_plur} and nutmeg grated over at the last moment.

FlavorText.FlavorDef.label: coconut panna cotta
FlavorText.FlavorDef.description: {1_coll} brought to a tremble with grated {0_plur} and barely any {2_adj}, set with gelatine and then turned out. It has to tremble when the plate is set down; firm, it has failed.
